title: Security and Product Boundaries
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Security and Product Boundaries.
learning_objectives: Explain security and product boundaries using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for security and product boundaries
Assess failure and operational limits of security and product boundaries
concepts_covered: A real hosted Git platform needs authentication, authorization, repository protocol, isolation, and durable storage.
The CLI entry point starts the local repository/runner; source has no Git server, OAuth, container runner, or multi-user boundary.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
